Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — the team found the session helpful. We'd like to schedule a focused technical deep-dive next week to cover:
- network requirements and VPC connectivity patterns
- model variant footprint and recommended quantization for our t2-heavy workloads
- telemetry and tracing integration (OpenTelemetry, logs, and token-level cost breakdowns)

Attendees on our side: myself (Platform), Rajiv Patel (Solutions Architect), and Mira Gomez (SRE). Prefer afternoon PST slots. Do you have 60–90 minute availability on Apr 9 or Apr 10? Also can you share a short agenda and any checklist we should prepare?

Best,
Olivia

Hi Olivia — great to hear. Yes, we can do a 75-minute technical deep-dive. Proposed slot windows (PT):
- Fri Apr 9, 2:00–3:15 PM PT
- Fri Apr 9, 4:00–5:15 PM PT
- Sat Apr 10, 11:00 AM–12:15 PM PT (if necessary)

Draft agenda (attached as redwood-tds-agenda.pdf):
1) Introductions & goals (5–10m)
2) Architecture walkthrough — serving runtime, smart routing, and KV/prefix caching (20m)
3) Network & deployment patterns — VPC, private deployments, VPC peering, egress considerations (20m)
4) Instrumentation & SLOs — telemetry, tracing, and cost dashboards (15m)
5) Open Q&A & next steps (10m)

Pre-reads / items to prepare on your side:
- a short note on expected peak qps and typical sequence length distribution
- permissive IP ranges for a quick connectivity test (we'll provide a checklist)

Karthik and Marissa will cover the runtime + infra sections. We can host via Google Meet; I'll send a calendar invite once you pick a slot. Also attaching a compact connectivity checklist (vertexai-network-checklist.xlsx) for your infra/SREs.

Camila Reyes
